description: Display of internally illuminated fascia and projecting signs.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the reports, specifications and drawings detailed Existing shopfront signage (Uploaded 15th May 2026), Shopfront visual (Uploaded 15th May 2026), Proposed signs (Uploaded 24th June 2026)  

Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme.

Condition : 2 - The maximum steady brightness of the fascia sign hereby permitted is not to exceed 200 candelas per sq.m.
Reason: To ensure the sign does not have an adverse effect on the amenity of the area in accordance with Council policy LP9 of the Local Plan and to comply with paragraph 141 of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Condition : 3 - The maximum steady brightness of the projecting sign hereby permitted is not to exceed 200 candelas per sq.m. 
Reason: To ensure the proposed sign does not have an adverse effect on the amenity of the area in accordance with Council policy LP9 of the Local Plan and to comply with paragraph 141 of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Condition : 4 - The illumination of the signs hereby permitted shall be by static illumination only. 
Reason: In the interest of highway safety and of the visual amenities of the locality in accordance with Council policy LP9 of the Local Plan and to comply with paragraph 141 of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Condition : 5 - INFORMATIVE: The application site is on or close to the Strategic Road Network (SRN) for which TfL has oversight responsibility and the Local Authority is the highway authority. No access should be created onto the SRN as part of the construction works. The footway and carriageway must not be blocked during any works associated with the development. All vehicles associated with the development during the works or subsequently must comply with existing on-street restrictions.

Various bus routes are supported by roads adjacent or close to the application site. The proposed development, including any works or deliveries, should not impact the operation of bus services, bus stops or the safety, comfort and convenience of bus passengers, pedestrians and highway safety generally.

Condition : 6 - INFORMATIVE: On highways under TfL's jurisdiction, the minimum acceptable safe clearance between the lowest part of the projecting sign, awning, canopy etc. and the footway is 2.5m; they may not project over the carriageway. Licencing may be required for certain operations including oversailing, planters, A-boards, tables and chairs etc: https://tfl.gov.uk/info-for/urbanplanning-and-construction/our-land-and-infrastructure/highwaylicences?intcmp=3496
